$comment: Named exceptions to site.identity.sister-brand (spec/observer-check-map.json). A sister-brand word on an Alpha campus page is a defect unless it matches an allowed phrase here, appears in the shared header/footer/navigation, is a proper noun that merely contains the word (universities, venues), or is rendered by a HubSpot-fed event card. tests/page-check.mjs reads this file; the observer should too. Add an exception only with the campus owner's decision recorded in docs/decisions.md.

brownsville.decision: Alpha Brownsville and Nova Academy share an application path; the resources block carries an Apply for Nova High School button by design (spec/observer-check-map.json, protocols/recipes/media-copy-links.md).
